new_claims.statement: For an original-coordinate cross block M and any 1/2<=h<3/4, if G_h is the maximum determinant-entropy currency over physical 3x3-minor weights with every row marginal <=h, then ||p_Q||inf <=6 sqrt(e)(2h)^(-1/2)(3-4h)^(-1) G_h^(-1/6), with a continuous C0 density.

G_h has the exact nonnegative-lambda entropy dual. For every integer m>3/h some |H|<=m satisfies E3(M_{H^c,*})<=E3(M)(G_h/E3(M))^((1-3/m)/(1-h)). At h=2/3,m=6, failure of a quantitative Fourier exit forces a six-row hub; two orientations give a six-by-six compound hub.
If G_{2/3}(M)=0, fractional matching/vertex-cover duality gives |H|<=4 meeting every supported row triple, hence rank(M_{H^c,*})<=2.

peer_result_applied.application: After conditioning the <=4 exact support-deficiency hub coordinates, residual rank-two cross block B obeys sup_u E(|R-u|^-1/2|X_H)<=8(sigma1 sigma2)^-1/4 uniformly in conditioned values.
